editorial.thesis: A hospitality-and-learning city of about 701,000. Its retail is heavy on desserts, sweets & ice cream and coaching & training, and thin on cafés, tea & coffee and grocery & daily needs — and 5% of residents live in zones with under 60% of the city's average retail depth.
takeaways: Branded retail is about 43% of Lucknow's. 4.85 chain outlets per lakh residents against 11.31 in Lucknow; 18 of the 51 national brands we track are present, led by Domino's 5, Reliance Trends 3, Tanishq 3.

The mapped economy leans to hotels & stays. Shares of all mapped places: hotels & stays 8.7% (Lucknow 5.1%); education 14.1% (Lucknow 11.2%); services & crafts 5.1% (Lucknow 7.6%); grocery & daily needs 1.0% (Lucknow 1.4%). Raw counts would mislead because Lucknow is mapped more completely (35,749 places against 3,039), so we compare mix, not counts.
Supply and demand are misaligned. 1 zones hold 5% of residents with under 60% of the city's average retail depth. Raya alone has about 33,000 residents and 3 mapped food & drink places.
Retail is less concentrated than in Lucknow. 46% of commercial places sit in the busiest tenth of the city (Lucknow 46%). The largest cores are Jn Rs · City (1,063 places) and Krishna Nagar (460).

The widest brand gaps against Lucknow. Bata 2 outlets vs 47; Reliance Trends 3 outlets vs 44; Domino's 5 outlets vs 42. These are leads to check against live listings, not verdicts: a brand may trade under another name or have opened since the map was updated.

numbers.title: The city in eight numbers
numbers.deck: A 6 km circle around the centre, processed with the same rules as Lucknow, so every comparison is like for like. Where raw counts would mislead — because a bigger city is mapped more completely — we compare shares and mix instead.

map.title: Where people live, where shops are
map.deck: Switch layers. The amber “gap” layer is the one to study: it marks places with many residents but little retail around them. Hover any hexagon (about 0.1 km²) for its numbers; click a zone on the right to isolate it.

captions.residents: Where people live. Jn Rs · City and Krishna Nagar are the largest zones by residents (379,000 and 164,000). Modelled residents per square kilometre.
captions.supply: Where the shops are. The busiest tenth of cells hold 46% of all commercial places, and Jn Rs · City alone lists 1,063.
captions.chains: Where the brands are. Jn Rs · City holds 17 of the 34 tracked chain outlets, and Krishna Nagar adds 7.
captions.education: Where the campuses are. Jn Rs · City and Krishna Nagar lead on education places (206 and 82, with 72 and 32 coaching centres) — a daytime youth market that residents alone do not show.
captions.gap: The gap. Amber: many residents nearby, little retail. Blue: far more retail than local residents explain — the commercial cores that draw people in. The deepest amber sits in Raya. The blue cores include Jn Rs · City.

zones.title: Zone by zone, by PIN code
zones.deck: Each zone is a postal-code area. Residents are modelled counts; places are mapped businesses and services. “Retail depth” is places per 10,000 residents — the tick marks the city average. Click a row to see it on the map.

mix.title: What the retail layer is made of
mix.deck: Raw counts per resident would favour whichever city is mapped more completely (35,749 places in Lucknow against 3,039 here). So this compares each category's share of all mapped places. 100 means the same share as Lucknow; below 100 is thinner, above is stronger.
mix.note: Against Lucknow, Mathura's mapped places over-index on hotels & stays (8.7% vs 5.1%), education (14.1% vs 11.2%), automotive (3.1% vs 2.7%) and under-index on services & crafts (5.1% vs 7.6%), grocery & daily needs (1.0% vs 1.4%), food & beverage (5.1% vs 6.9%).

chains.title: Who is mapped here, and who is not
chains.deck: 34 outlets of 18 tracked national brands within 6 km — 4.85 per lakh residents against Lucknow's 11.31 (483 outlets of 33 brands). Filled names have at least one mapped outlet (count shown); dashed names have none.
chains.note: Read dashed names as leads, not verdicts. “No mapped outlet” can mean a brand trades under a different listed name, or has opened since the map was updated. The widest gaps against Lucknow are Bata (2 vs 47); Reliance Trends (3 vs 44); Domino's (5 vs 42). Premium reports check every lead against live listings.

formats.title: Which formats have room
formats.deck: 9 formats, thinnest first. The index is the format's share of all mapped places relative to Lucknow's, so low means thin by Lucknow's standard. “Where to look” ranks zones with at least 40,000 residents by residents per mapped outlet — a first-pass screen for where one more outlet would face the least local competition.

people.title: Who the customers are
people.deck: Age mix inside the 6 km circle, from Meta's age rasters (modelled, not a census).
people.note: Mathura's age mix against Lucknow: children (0–14) 32.3% vs 22.9%, 15–24 21.0% vs 21.5%, working age 39.5% vs 47.6%, 60+ 7.2% vs 7.9%. Under-25s are 53% of residents.

zones.281001: Reasonably supplied: 1,063 places for about 379,000 residents (index 96), 17 chain outlets.
zones.281004: Reasonably supplied: 460 places for about 164,000 residents (index 96), 7 chain outlets.
zones.281003: Reasonably supplied: 115 places for about 60,000 residents (index 66), 0 chain outlets.
zones.281204: An under-served zone: about 33,000 residents, 21 mapped places, 3 food & drink and 0 chain outlets. Depth index 22.
zones.281006: Reasonably supplied: 51 places for about 25,000 residents (index 71), 1 chain outlet.

restaurants.read: Restaurants & fast food are 3.6% of mapped places against 4.6% in Lucknow — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Domino's 5 (Lucknow 42), McDonald's 2 (Lucknow 11), La Pino'z 2 (Lucknow 5), Pizza Hut 1 (Lucknow 20). No mapped outlet in either city: Biryani By Kilo, Faasos.
restaurants.watch: Independent eateries are numerous and unevenly mapped. Treat the index as a screen and confirm competitor density street by street.

cafes.read: Cafés, tea & coffee are 1.5% of mapped places against 2.2% in Lucknow — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Café Coffee Day 1 (Lucknow 24). No mapped outlet in either city: Chaayos, Chai Point, Blue Tokai, Third Wave Coffee.
cafes.watch: Chai stalls and independent cafés are under-mapped. A café concept here competes on price and habit as much as on novelty.

desserts.read: Desserts, sweets & ice cream are 0.7% of mapped places against 0.5% in Lucknow — above its share. Mapped chain outlets: Baskin Robbins 1 (Lucknow 18). No mapped outlet in either city: Havmor, Naturals, Theobroma, Cream Stone.
desserts.watch: Traditional sweet shops are the real benchmark and sit outside most chain lists.

grocery.read: Grocery & daily needs are 1.0% of mapped places against 1.4% in Lucknow — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Vishal Mega Mart 2 (Lucknow 15), Reliance Smart / Fresh 1 (Lucknow 11). No mapped outlet in either city: Easyday, Star Bazaar.
grocery.watch: Neighbourhood kirana stores are the real incumbents and the least completely mapped outlets, so any gap is overstated. Test a site against local store density before acting.

pharmacy.read: Pharmacy & health retail are 1.3% of mapped places against 1.8% in Lucknow — below its share. No mapped outlet in either city: MedPlus, Wellness Forever, Frank Ross.
pharmacy.watch: Independent chemists are dense and lightly mapped. Hospital and clinic clusters are the natural anchors.

apparel.read: Apparel, footwear & jewellery are 4.4% of mapped places against 5.5% in Lucknow — below its share. Mapped chain outlets: Reliance Trends 3 (Lucknow 44), Tanishq 3 (Lucknow 12), V-Mart 2 (Lucknow 27), Bata 2 (Lucknow 47). No mapped outlet in either city: Zudio.
apparel.watch: Established multi-brand traders and local bazaars sit behind these numbers; new entrants compete with them as well as with chains.

banking.read: Banks & ATMs are 7.4% of mapped places against 6.9% in Lucknow, so the mix is level.
banking.watch: This category includes insurance and agency offices, so it overstates branch banking. Use it as a signal of commercial activity, not a branch count.

coaching.read: Coaching & training are 4.2% of mapped places against 3.8% in Lucknow — above its share.
coaching.watch: Coaching demand follows the exam calendar. Formats that depend on it should be tested across the academic year.

fitness.read: Fitness & wellness are 3.1% of mapped places against 4.4% in Lucknow — below its share.
fitness.watch: Gym listings change often and are inconsistently categorised; verify before drawing conclusions.
